title: Place/transition Petri net for the model-check engine
description: A basic place/transition net after Holzmann §8.10 (plan 14 §2.2, §5.3): places carry an integer marking with an optional capacity (default 255); transitions consume from input places and produce into output places with integer multiplicities of at least 1. Arrays fix the engine's deterministic order. Test-for-absence arcs are not representable: every object is closed and an arc has only a place and a multiplicity.

name.description: Optional net name used in reports.

places.description: Places in the order the engine will use.

initial.description: Initial marking: number of tokens in this place.

capacity.description: Maximum number of tokens; an effect that would exceed it is reported as invalid-model. Default 255 (a Promela byte, as in App_C/petrinet1).

meaning.description: What a token in this place stands for (condition, control point or resource) — used to decode counterexamples.

transitions.description: Transitions in the order the engine will use.

inputs.description: Arcs from places to this transition. The transition is enabled when every input place holds at least the arc's multiplicity.

outputs.description: Arcs from this transition to places. Firing adds the arc's multiplicity to each output place.

meaning.description: What firing this transition stands for in the source system.

identifier.description: Place or transition name; must be unique within its list.

multiplicity.description: Tokens moved along this arc per firing. 1 is Holzmann's basic net; larger values are the plan's extension.
